stemBlocks: The graph shows the rate of transpiration at different temperatures for a plant in its natural environment.
Which of the following statements is/are correct?

1 Stomata open when the guard cells lose water and become flaccid.
2 Between $20 \text{ °C}$ and $27 \text{ °C}$, the humidity around the leaves must have decreased.
3 The air speed around the leaves could be higher at $23 \text{ °C}$ than at $30 \text{ °C}$.

assets.alt: Graph showing rate of transpiration ($/\text{g m}^{-2}\text{s}^{-1}$) versus temperature ($/\text{°C}$). The rate increases from $20 \text{ °C}$ to $27 \text{ °C}$ and then decreases from $27 \text{ °C}$ to $30 \text{ °C}$.
